text:
Lia: Quick alert — Globex POC demo script is getting intermittent 429s on /v1/chat.generate during a load test. Demo in 90m. They9re using 6 parallel processes hitting generate.chat with ~1.2k token prompts each. Any immediate ideas?

Priya: Oof 6x1.2k is heavy. Are they using streaming or blocking calls? Which model variant?

Lia: Blocking calls, model: chat-small-plus, tenant: globex-poc-7. They also mentioned their client retries every 200ms on failure (no jitter).

Marco: That retry pattern will amplify a transient per-route throttle into a storm. If server returns Retry-After our clients should respect it. Send me a sample response?

Lia: Their logfile snippet:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: 2026-03-22T09:34:12Z
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "rate_limit",
  "retry_after_ms": 900,
  "route": "/v1/chat.generate",
  "tenant_id": "globex-poc-7",
  "inflight_tokens": 72000
}
```

Priya: That retry_after is short but their 200ms retry cycle means lots of requests will retry simultaneously after ~200,400,600ms until one succeeds. We need two parallel actions: (1) immediate mitigation to get demo green, (2) client guidance to fix retry/backoff and batching.

Marco: For immediate mitigation I can apply a per-route short override to raise tokens_per_min to 400k for 45 minutes for globex-poc-7 on /v1/chat.generate. I also suggest enabling server-side slow-start: limit concurrent requests from that tenant to 4 while override is active. That requires infra/admin access.

ratebot: [automated] Override request endpoint: POST /internal/admin/overrides {"tenant_id":"<id>","route":"<route>","tokens_per_min":<n>,"concurrency_limit":<m>,"duration_min":<d>} 10 team approval required for concurrency_change.

Ben: Ben here, customer confirmed demo importance. Approving tokens_per_min bump and short concurrency change for demo. They accept we will monitor and revert.

Marco: Applying override now. Creating ov-20260322-07 with tokens_per_min=400000 and concurrency_limit=4, duration_min=45.

ratebot: [automated] Override ov-20260322-07 applied by Marco for tenant globex-poc-7: /v1/chat.generate tokens_per_min=400000 concurrency_limit=4 duration_min=45.

Lia: Told Globex they can resume the scripted load in 5m. Also gave them a small client patch: add exponential backoff with jitter (base 300ms, cap 5s) and respect Retry-After header.

Priya: For post-demo follow-up: recommend they (1) move to streaming responses to reduce inflight tokens, (2) reduce per-request prompt length where possible, (3) implement adaptive concurrency client-side (target 3-4 workers), (4) add jittered retry. I9ll author a short POC advisory doc and snippet.

Marco: Monitoring now. If we see quota creeping past override I will alert. I scheduled revert at 10:20Z to give them cushion.

ratebot: [automated] Override ov-20260322-07 scheduled end 10:20Z.

Ben: I9ll note the temporary concession in the deal notes and add action item for engineering handoff to make the change permanent if they need it.

Lia: Demo ran at 10:05 and Globex reported clean results after the patch. No 429s observed during the 30m post-demo window.

Marco: Reverted override at 10:18Z. No follow-up alerts.

Priya: I pushed the advisory doc and a code snippet to the POC repo: recommended_retry.md and client_backoff_example.py. Link shared with SEs.

Lia: Closing thread 1 A good reminder to always ask about client retry behavior during presales load tests.
